decision.summary: No confirmed temporary offset intervals. Two uncertain candidates identified: (1) a sharp U drop at 620–624 without clear return or compensating N/E motion; (2) a prolonged 590–664 interval with complex cross-axis trends lacking a definable offset onset-return pair. Missing observations at indices 665, 683, 692 prevent confirmation of returns. Original data show no isolated step with symmetric recovery across axes.

intervals.observation: U drops sharply (~-2.7 to -4.4) over indices 620–624; N and E show divergent trends (N becomes more negative, E rises), but no clear opposing return in U or coordinated reversal in N/E within allowed context. Return not observed before index 699.

Extended cross-axis behavior from ~590–664: U declines overall, N shows transient negative excursion then partial recovery, E rises steadily. No coherent multi-axis offset signature with defined onset/return; motion appears superposed or smooth rather than a discrete temporary offset.
